annotations.text:
Poster — A3 at 96ppi (1123×1587).
Palette lifted from assets/hero.gif, not invented.
Bracketed fields are real facts I don't have — fill them in.

Ink direction: same structure on paper white.
Upside: photocopies and grayscales cleanly, drinks no ink.
Tradeoff: loses the estate's dark, screen-native identity.

Slate direction: headline sits INSIDE a 16:9 film frame,
fan-out becomes a timeline strip below it.
Upside: unmistakably about video. Tradeoff: the frame eats
the headline's scale, so it reads weaker at distance.
